neighbours.label: The verb that ties an event or sample to a time or source (came a day after, comes as, taken from, conducted on); promotes when, where, current. Other verbs with the same subjects stay quiet
fire: Tuesday's blast came hours after talks collapsed.
The minister's comments came days after the strike.
The resignation comes as the party faces a probe.
Samples were collected from 40 rural clinics.
The analysis was performed on 212 adults.
Records were obtained from the national registry.
The arrests came a week after the raid.
Today's ruling comes amid rising tension.
quiet: Tuesday's blast shook the windows downtown.
The minister's comments angered the striking miners.
The resignation surprised the party's younger members.
Samples were red and smelled faintly of iron.
The analysis was hard and took many weeks.
Records were high this season for rainfall.
The arrests shocked the quiet little town.
Today's ruling is long and very technical.

short: verb tying event to time or source
